description: Organizational cybersecurity risk management performance is not evaluated and reviewed.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Enterprise governance and leadership functions Strategic planning and risk management teams Organizations subject to regulatory compliance requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify organizations without established cybersecurity performance metrics and KPIs, lack of regular performance reporting to leadership, absence of maturity assessments or capability evaluations, or failure to implement continuous improvement based on performance reviews.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls
